title: Athirst
summary: ATHIRST', adjective athrust'. [a and thirst. See Thirst.] 1. Thirsty; wanting drink. 2. Having a keen appetite or desire. He had a soul athirst for knowledge.

inlines.v: ATHIRST', adjective athrust'. [a and thirst. See Thirst.] 1. Thirsty; wanting drink. 2. Having a keen appetite or desire. He had a soul athirst for knowledge.
